verdict.rationale: Exa has a public pricing page with a self-serve, credit-based model: $20 in credits on sign-up and $10 every month, with no payment method required. Its docs also state that contents features are bundled at no extra charge for up to 10 results per search, so a developer can start without contacting sales. However, the evidence never shows actual per-request or per-credit rates for search, contents, Agent or Websets, so the pricing is visibly self-serve but not shown to be clearly itemized. Missing for 10: published per-request/per-credit unit prices per endpoint or search type, volume/tier breakdown, independent confirmation that pricing is clear without sales contact.
